bio: Architect Dudok is the designer behind this trendy 1930s pavilion. Each table overlooks the Hilversum Canal, which really is something to behold as you sit on the gorgeous terrace. The resolutely modern cuisine shows a preference for organic and local produce, yet remains down-to-earth. For a variety of fish dishes with Asian nuances or a perfectly cooked piece of meat with an exquisite sauce, this is the place to come. The daily specials never disappoint. The restaurant also rents out boats!...
